scientific.integrity: The Flooding update is specialized directly to a scalar quadratic. The logarithmic piecewise translation is proved exactly and conjugated to a rigid circle rotation; the ergodic loss formulas are then evaluated analytically. The endpoint exact-solve case is classified separately by a finite doubling argument.
limitations: Complete orbit classification is for deterministic scalar quadratics.
The rotation theorem assumes \(0<h<1\) and excludes the countable exact-boundary-hit set.
The endpoint \(h=1\) uses the explicit kink convention \(\operatorname{sign}(0)=0\).
Stochastic minibatching, momentum, adaptive preconditioning, and higher-dimensional coupling are not analyzed.
No generalization claim is made from the below-target time average.

title: Flooding has a below-target ergodic mean and a zero-loss resonance on quadratics
